title: On Comprising ten short chapters
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：comprise　|　正文 329 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 comprise 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the engineer ① comprised ten short chapters in silence, and every worker in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the engineer ② comprises ten short chapters twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ comprise ten short chapters at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ comprised ten short chapters before — a line in the manual for April 1976 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Comprising ten short chapters in silence, the engineer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lever at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ comprise all the land east of the road twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Comprise all the land east of the road at once and never mention it again.

By 1989 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the manual, and a new worker from the next workshop ⑧ comprises all the land east of the road in silence every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ comprised ten short chapters again when nobody else would.

⑩ To comprise ten short chapters, my mother said in 1994, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the workshop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the workshop forgets, somebody comprises ten short chapters twice over again and somebody must comprise ten short chapters in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 包含（一般过去式 comprised ten short chapters：1982 年工程师头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 包含（一般现在 comprises ten short chapters：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 包含（不定式 to comprise ten short chapters：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 包含（过去完成时 had comprised ten short chapters：1976 年四月的说明书上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 包含（动名词 comprising ten short chapters 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 由…组成（comprise all the land east of the road：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去由…组成路东的全部田地）
G. v. 由…组成（comprise all the land east of the road：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 包含（后段两处：新来的工人照例 comprises all the land east of the road，而母亲又一次 comprised ten short chapters）

items.q: comprise all the land east of the road twice over
comprise all the land east of the road at once
comprises all the land east of the road in silence

answers.why: comprise 意为“包含”，1982 年工程师一言不发地包含十章不长，那是车间里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 comprised。
comprise 意为“包含”，自那以后工程师来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 comprises。
comprise 意为“包含”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯包含十章不长”，此处为不定式 to comprise ten short chapters。
comprise 意为“包含”，说明书里 四月 那行字说明早在 1989 年之前就有人包含过，故用过去完成时 had comprised。
comprise 意为“包含”，工程师说“包含十章不长这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 comprising ten short chapters 作主语。
comprise 意为“由…组成”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去由…组成路东的全部田地”，should ever 之后用原形 comprise all the land east of the road。
comprise 意为“由…组成”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻由…组成路东的全部田地（comprise all the land east of the road at once），以后再也不要提起。
comprise 意为“包含”，新来的工人每个年头都照例由…组成路东的全部田地，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 comprises。
comprise 意为“包含”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地包含十章不长，用一般过去式 comprised 叙述。
comprise 意为“包含”，结尾那句是母亲 1994 年的话：要包含十章不长，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车间记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1982 年，工程师一言不发地包含十章不长；车间里每一个工人都说这是头一回。（comprised ten short chapters）
多年以后，工程师仍来回两遍做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（comprises ten short chapters）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯包含十章不长这件事本身。（to comprise ten short chapters）
早在 1976 年就有人包含十章不长，四月那天说明书上的一行字就是证据。（had comprised ten short chapters）
工程师说过，一言不发地包含十章不长这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（comprising ten short chapters 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻由…组成路东的全部田地，以后再也不要提起。（comprise all the land east of the road，祈使句）
answers: In 1982 the engineer comprised ten short chapters in silence, and every worker in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three years on, the engineer still comprises ten short chapters twice over without being asked.
My mother said later that to comprise ten short chapters at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had comprised ten short chapters long before 1989, and the line in the manual for April proves it.
Comprising ten short chapters in silence, the engineer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Comprise all the land east of the road at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 comprise 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1982 the engineer comprised ten short chapters in silence, and nobody in the workshop forgot it.
Even now the engineer comprises ten short chapters twice over whenever the workshop asks.
Comprising ten short chapters in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever comprise all the land east of the road twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next workshop comprises all the land east of the road in silence every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother comprised ten short chapters again, and the workshop remembered that half.
